ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Windows Defender Folder Exclusion Added Via Reg.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage of "reg.exe" to add Defender folder exclusions. Qbot has been seen using this technique to add exclusions for folders within AppData and ProgramData.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Exclusions\\\\Paths.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Microsoft\\ Antimalware\\\\Exclusions\\\\Paths.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ADD\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/t\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*REG\\_DWORD\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/d\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*0.*")))
